column1: # Total basis: whole-image AOT range manifest excluding the leading callback table.

column2: note
function start — BattleLoaderResetVisualEntityState; clears loader globals and initializes eleven visual-entity records from the selected party and character-versus-Gear state.
function start — BattleLoaderConfigureEntityLayout; builds party and enemy slot mappings and resolves each active entity's initial arena position.
function start — BattleLoaderLoadEnemyDefinitions; copies eight selected enemy definitions relocates their script pointers and clears enemy script variables.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializePartyDisplayState; applies initial party status and selects AP fuel or hidden HUD displays from character and Gear state.
function start — BattleLoaderBuildBattleInventory; clamps quantities removes empty entries and compacts usable character and Gear items into Battle inventory arrays.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeTurnOrder; randomizes entity indices applies immediate-readiness flags and normalizes initial readiness timers.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeCommandsAndTargets; installs party command layouts computes facing targets and enforces no-Gear and no-escape restrictions.
function start — BattleLoaderLoadPartyResources; copies party and Gear statistics decompresses combat UI resources uploads portraits and queues encounter configuration files.
function start — BattleLoaderRunInitializationPhase; dispatches the four staged Battle initialization phases from core resources through HUD creation.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeHudPrimitives; initializes textured gauges AP and fuel polygons font palettes and line primitives for the party HUD.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeOverlayPrimitives; creates paired semitransparent quads and draw-mode packets used by Battle UI overlays.
function start — BattleLoaderRenderItemTargetLabels; allocates ten small text textures and renders localized item-target labels into them.
function start — BattleLoaderBuildPartyHudText; builds status labels name strips and HP and MP primitives for each occupied party member.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializePartyHud; initializes both general HUD primitives and party-specific HUD text.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeItemTargetUi; initializes overlay packets and pre-renders item-target label textures.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateSpriteLoadingTask; creates the asynchronous Battle sprite loader while guarding task creation with the resident flag.
function start — BattleLoaderInstallEnemyVisualAssets; uploads enemy sprite sheets binds animation streams resolves shared visuals and initializes enemy Gear meshes.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateEnemySpriteActors; creates normal sprite actors for occupied enemy slots with resolved sprite data.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateSpriteActor; allocates and configures a Battle sprite actor with entity position direction animation and visibility state.
function start — BattleLoaderQueuePartySpriteFiles; builds and starts requests for non-Gear party character sprite packages.
function start — BattleLoaderStartPartyGearEntranceLoads; creates Gear loading tasks for occupied party slots that enter Battle as Gears.
function start — BattleLoaderCreatePartySpriteActors; creates normal party sprites assigns VRAM and animation resources and starts entrance animation where required.
function start — BattleLoaderWaitForPartyLanding; waits for all normal party actors to reach terrain height then enables Battle time and removes the loader task.
function start — BattleLoaderBeginPartyLandingDelay; starts the final sixteen-frame entrance delay and switches to the landing-completion callback.
function start — BattleLoaderWaitForMusicAndStartGearEntrances; waits for music readiness releases its temporary resource and starts party Gear entrances.
function start — BattleLoaderUploadCommonSpriteTextures; decompresses and uploads the common Battle sprite texture package then synchronizes the GPU.
function start — BattleLoaderFinalizeCommonSpriteAssets; uploads common textures initializes animations loads the Battle sequence and advances entrance handling.
function start — BattleLoaderQueueCommonSpriteAssets; creates party sprites and queues common textures animations and the Battle sequence from directory 0x2C.
function start — BattleLoaderFinalizeEnemySpritesAndQueuePartyAssets; installs enemy visuals creates enemy actors frees their package and queues party sprite files.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateSpriteLoadingTaskInternal; allocates the sprite-loader task installs its initial callback and stores the encounter sprite package.
function start — BattleLoaderComputeEnvironmentTextureBounds; scans relocated TIM entries and caches the Battle environment texture bounds and pixel area.
function start — BattleLoaderLoadEnvironment; relocates and installs environment models textures bones panoramas ground terrain image commands lighting and matrices.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateEnvironmentGroundPlane; builds a textured 9 by 9 vertex ground grid with double-buffered cells palette and draw-state packets.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeTerrain; installs terrain vertices and triangles records the count and clears traversal-generation markers.
function start — BattleLoaderUpdateTileTransition; advances 140 transition tiles by fading colors and optionally moving them vertically.
function start — BattleLoaderRenderTileTransitionToMainOt; selects the resident main ordering table and forwards the tile effect to its renderer.
function start — BattleLoaderRenderTileTransition; transforms and submits every visible transition tile while preserving the prior GTE projection state.
function start — BattleLoaderFreeTileTransition; synchronizes pending GPU work and frees the tile-transition allocation.
function start — BattleLoaderDeleteTileTransitionTask; unregisters the tile task releases its render state and frees the task object.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateTileTransition; allocates and initializes the tile-transition state object and render pointers.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeTileTransition; builds two 10 by 7 tile layers with positions UVs colors and double-buffered textured quads.
function start — BattleLoaderRunTileRiseTransitionMode1; captures the framebuffer and runs a rising fading tile transition while interleaving staged Battle loading.
function start — BattleLoaderRunTileFadeTransitionMode4; selects stationary tiles and invokes the common tile-transition loader loop.
function start — BattleLoaderUpdateTriangleTransition; advances triangle-transition frame brightness scale rotation and movement parameters for the selected mode.
function start — BattleLoaderRenderTriangleTransition; transforms shades clips and submits 560 textured framebuffer fragments.
function start — BattleLoaderFreeTriangleTransition; synchronizes the GPU and frees the triangle-transition allocation.
function start — BattleLoaderDeleteTriangleTransitionTask; unregisters and frees the task that owns the triangle transition.
function start — BattleLoaderCreateTriangleTransition; allocates and initializes the large triangular transition object.
function start — BattleLoaderInitializeTriangleTransition; builds two 20 by 14 triangle layers with coordinates phase values UVs and double-buffered packets.
function start — BattleLoaderRunTriangleBurstTransitionMode2; captures the framebuffer and runs an expanding triangular-fragment transition while interleaving Battle loading.
function start — BattleLoaderRunTriangleSpiralTransitionMode3; selects rotating triangular-fragment motion and invokes the common triangle transition driver.
